facts.fact: ACET says Mauritius' 2018 AI strategy, the earliest in Africa, was reviewed and a newer version adopted; the 2018 document is superseded (date taken from the 10 April 2026 UNDP launch it cites).
ACET says Mauritius adopted a newer national AI strategy, launched 10 April 2026 with UNDP support, and is in the second phase of implementation.
